trace.final:
All done. Here's what happened:

**Rollback (completed)**
- Identified that v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
- Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0. The first attempt failed partway (an orchestrator error halted the rollout after us-east), so I retried it and the second attempt completed the rollout across all regions.
- Confirmed service status afterward: all regions on v2.3.0, **healthy**, error rate down from 18% → 0.2%.

**Incident (opened)**
- Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2, checkout-api, on-call paged) documenting the health check failures on v2.3.1, the rollback to v2.3.0, the partial-failure/retry detail, and the resolution status (service healthy, error rate normalized).
- Note: v2.3.1 was never healthy in production (and was also unhealthy in staging), so per policy any future attempt to redeploy it will require change-manager approval — worth flagging in the incident follow-up once root cause is understood.
